title: DCP Approval Artifact (.v0)
description: SYNTHESIS_INVENTED envelope + REPO_VALIDATED tier/decision vocabulary / PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT. Represents a supervisor approval RECORD for a proposed mutation class. This artifact does NOT execute the mutation and must not become a write executor. INVARIANT: requester != approver (no self-certification). LIVE_WRITE_READY must not be defined. schema_version .v0 = unstable, not authority.

schema_version.description: .v0 suffix per K-27; unstable version marker, not an authority claim.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for this contract instance.

provenance.description: Contract-level provenance. SYNTHESIS_INVENTED envelope; tier/decision vocabulary is REPO_VALIDATED from policy.py.

state.description: Const-pinned for .v0 SYNTHESIS_INVENTED envelope. May not exit .v0 until repo-local reconciliation.

validation_state.description: Const-pinned for .v0 SYNTHESIS_INVENTED contract. The tier/decision vocabulary sub-fields are REPO_VALIDATED but the envelope itself is SYNTHESIS_INVENTED.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance tags for all fields in this artifact instance.

approval_id.description: Unique identifier for this approval record.

requested_action_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the mutation action being approved. Corresponds to CapabilityPolicy.title pattern from policy.py.

mutation_class.description: Class ID from DCP_MUTATION_CLASS registry (e.g. MC-SOURCE-CONFIG, MC-GITHUB-MUTATION).

approval_tier.description: Approval tier from REQUIRED_TIERS in policy.py. REPO_VALIDATED vocabulary.

requester.description: Identity of the requester. INVARIANT: must not equal approver. No self-certification.

approver.description: Identity of the approver. INVARIANT: must not equal requester. Separate actor required.

supervisor_signoff.description: Supervisor sign-off record. Required for T4+ mutations per policy.py T4_PLUS gate. PROVISIONAL: supervisor identity resolution not proven wired to runtime.

required.description: Whether supervisor signoff is required (true for T4+ tiers per policy.py T4_PLUS).

provided.description: Whether supervisor signoff has been provided.

signoff_identity.description: Identity of the supervisor who signed off, or null if not yet provided.

approved_artifact_refs.description: References to artifacts approved by this record. Pattern from proof.py _validate_manifest generated_artifacts.

proof_refs.description: References to proof bundles associated with this approval.

head_sha_or_digest.description: HEAD SHA or artifact digest under review. In .v0 fixtures: value must be an illustrative placeholder (no live SHA computation).

value.description: Git SHA or digest. In .v0 fixtures: sha256:PLACEHOLDER-illustrative-not-computed.

freshness_state.description: Freshness/status of the approved artifact. Vocabulary from proof.py ALLOWED_PROOF_STATUSES + UNKNOWN. REPO_VALIDATED vocabulary.

red_lanes_present.description: Red lane IDs from DCP_RED_LANE_TAXONOMY that are present or triggered in this approval context.

forbidden_paths_acknowledged.description: Forbidden paths explicitly acknowledged by the approver. DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001 paths must appear here when relevant.

explicit_exclusions.description: Explicit exclusions from this approval scope. SYNTHESIS_INVENTED: no repo equivalent. Documents what is NOT approved.

expiry_window.description: Freshness/expiry window for this approval. SYNTHESIS_INVENTED: no proof freshness window defined in approval_policy.yaml.

value.description: Expiry window value, or null if no expiry.

decision.description: Decision from CapabilityPolicy.decision field vocabulary in policy.py. REPO_VALIDATED vocabulary.

decision_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the decision, or null if pending.

rationale.description: Human-readable rationale for the approval decision.

known_unknowns.description: Explicit unresolved unknowns for this approval instance.

red_lines.description: Red line IDs that apply to this artifact. Must reference DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001 when applicable.
